Fetch MMA schedule data from ESPN's unofficial API

Source: R/fetch_espn_mma_schedule.R
fetch_espn_mma_schedule.Rd

Retrieves MMA event schedules from ESPN's hidden API endpoints. This function provides access to upcoming and past MMA events including UFC, Bellator, PFL, and other major promotions covered by ESPN.

Usage

fetch_espn_mma_schedule(
  league = "ufc",
  dates = NULL,
  limit = 100,
  include_results = TRUE,
  timeout = 30,
  raw = FALSE
)

Arguments

league

Character. MMA league/promotion to fetch. Options include: "ufc" (default), "bellator", "pfl", or NULL for all MMA events.

dates

Character. Date or date range in YYYYMMDD format. Can be:

  • Single date: "20250801"

  • Date range: "20250801-20250831"

  • NULL for current/upcoming events (default)

limit

Integer. Maximum number of events to return (default: 100).

include_results

Logical. Whether to include completed fight results (default: TRUE).

timeout

Numeric. Request timeout in seconds (default: 30).

raw

Logical. If TRUE, assigns raw JSON to global environment. Default FALSE.

Value

Invisibly returns the data, but main purpose is global environment assignment.

Details

This function uses ESPN's unofficial/hidden API endpoints that are not officially documented or supported. The API structure may change without notice, and rate limiting may apply.

Important Notes:

  • This is an unofficial API - use at your own risk

  • ESPN may block requests or change endpoints without notice

  • Respect rate limits to avoid being blocked

  • Consider ESPN's terms of service

The function attempts multiple endpoint strategies and assigns cleaned data to the global environment as 'mma_schedule'.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Get current UFC events
fetch_espn_mma_schedule()
head(mma_schedule)

# Get UFC events for a specific date
fetch_espn_mma_schedule(league = "ufc", dates = "20250801")

# Get all MMA events for a date range
fetch_espn_mma_schedule(league = NULL, dates = "20250801-20250831", limit = 50)

# Get raw data
fetch_espn_mma_schedule(league = "ufc", raw = TRUE)
} # }
